scripts.build:wasm: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=../../.build/web/cargo wasm-pack build ../../crates/engine-wasm --release --target web --out-dir ../../apps/engine-web/pkg && (command -v wasm-opt >/dev/null && wasm-opt -Oz --all-features pkg/rebook_engine_wasm_bg.wasm -o pkg/rebook_engine_wasm_bg.wasm || true)
scripts.analyze:wasm: ls -lh pkg/*.wasm && (command -v wasm-opt >/dev/null && wasm-opt -Oz --all-features pkg/rebook_engine_wasm_bg.wasm -o pkg/rebook_engine_wasm_bg.wasm || echo 'wasm-opt not installed; install Binaryen for further shrinking')
